snippet.title: SpeedRunner Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Use your grappling hook, walljumping and other acrobatic skills to find the fastest route and speedrun as quickly as possible across 16 action-packed platforming levels, in order to dismantle the bomb in time!

Run, jump and swing to avoid spikes and obstacles, defeat the mad bomber and his diabolic machine, collect pickups and unlock bonus level in this gorgeous game, with music by award winning composer Musicbyjonathan 

Play online:
http://www.speedrunner-game.com

More info:
http://www.doubledutchgames.com
